title: Pre-existing: jmap-metadata-server rustdoc broken-intra-doc-link at lib.rs:50 [memory::MemoryBackend]
description:
Surfaced during bd:JMAP-ayoz.41.9 pre-commit rustdoc check.

`RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p jmap-metadata-server --no-deps` fails with:

```
error: unresolved link to `memory::MemoryBackend`
  --> crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/lib.rs:50:7
   |
50 | //! [`memory::MemoryBackend`] rustdoc for the full discussion.
   |       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ no item named `memory` in scope
```

The `memory` module is gated behind `feature = "memory"` and is not visible to the default `cargo doc` invocation. Either:
1. Wrap the docstring in `#[cfg_attr(feature = "memory", doc = ...)]` so the link is only rendered when the module is in scope, or
2. Document with `--all-features` in CI, or
3. Use a feature-conditional intra-doc link target.

Sibling precedent: bd:JMAP-ha4n (jmap-sharing-server). This bead is the metadata-server counterpart.

Out of scope for bd:JMAP-ayoz.41.9 — that bead's pre-commit rustdoc check is for regression detection on changes the bead made, not for fixing pre-existing rustdoc gaps. Verified pre-existing via `git stash` before/after on this checkout (the broken link exists on the same line at HEAD before .41.9's edits).
